claims.assertion: Yazhi says renaming UFOs as UAPs manipulates public perception but does not change what they are.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She portrays official disclosure as planned disinformation.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says souls choose an oblivion veil to avoid karmic and past-life memories before beginning a new life.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She links it to the frequency distance between the astral and earthly life.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says lower-astral entities exploit memory loss and are egregors of humanity's collective unconscious.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She includes archons and tulpas among these entities.
